create.name: David Gandelman
create.bio:
With a light and often humorous touch, meditation teacher and author David Gandelman teaches meditation, energy awareness and intuitive development. After studying Western philosophy at Rutgers University, he lived in the Himalayas, where he studied the spiritual traditions of the East, and later became director of a Hawaiian school devoted to mysticism and intuitive development. Cornell University has hosted his meditation teaching, as have organisations such as NBC Universal and SAP, and many people use his guided meditations on the Insight Timer app.

Meditation School, which he founded, is an online membership and app offering courses and daily meditations. He hosts three podcasts: Meditation School, Energy Matters and Grounded Sleep. Together with Cody Edner he runs the Energy Matters Academy, whose courses cover seeing and reading energy, the intuitive chakras and kundalini, alongside in-person retreats; with Michael Galyon he leads a meditation teacher training lasting a year. In The 7 Energies of the Soul he describes seven archetypal energies (creator, healer, warrior, lover, artist, explorer and master), offering exercises and meditations for balancing them. His course on The Shift Network, Third Eye Training, covers intuition and energy reading.

books.title: The 7 Energies of the Soul: Awaken Your Inner Creator, Healer, Warrior, Lover, Artist, Explorer, and Master
books.author: David Gandelman
books.description: A guide to seven archetypal energies of the soul: creator, healer, warrior, lover, artist, explorer and master. Each chapter offers exercises and meditations to help readers see which energies are strong or underused in them and work towards balance.

courses.title: Third Eye Training
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course on opening the third eye, developing intuition and reading energy. It also covers grounding, managing your own energy, and working with chakras, symbols and visualisation.

courses.title: Meditation School Membership
courses.description: An online membership with more than 300 hours of guided courses and daily meditations, organised into paths for different stages of practice. It includes courses on purpose, intuition and sleep as a practice, with a 30-day free trial.

courses.title: 2028 Meditation Teacher Training Certification
courses.description: A twelve-month online 250-hour certification led by David Gandelman and Michael Galyon. It covers teaching from presence, holding space for others, several meditation styles and building a livelihood as a teacher.

courses.title: Mastering Kundalini Energy
courses.description: A pre-recorded six-week course with David Gandelman and Cody Edner on awakening and directing kundalini energy. It teaches how to work with the energy centres safely and bring the practice into daily life.

courses.title: Learning to See Energy Series
courses.description: A twelve-class self-paced programme with David Gandelman and Cody Edner for beginning to notice, read and understand energy. It offers practical exercises for sensing energy and refining intuition in everyday life.

courses.title: Awakening The Intuitive Chakras
courses.description: Eight pre-recorded two-hour classes with David Gandelman and Cody Edner, each with a guided meditation. The course explores eight chakras and their intuitive abilities, with techniques for balancing and activating each one.

courses.title: Intuitive Energy Reading and Healing Retreat, Boulder
courses.description: A four-day in-person retreat at the StarHouse in Boulder, Colorado, open to all levels. Days include meditation, energy work, intuitive practice and time in nature with the Energy Matters teachers.

free_resources.title: The Foundations of Meditation
free_resources.description: A free beginner's workshop that teaches the basic techniques and ideas of meditation in a clear and humorous way. No experience is needed; you press play and follow along.

free_resources.title: The 7 Energies of the Soul Quiz
free_resources.description: A free online quiz based on his book that suggests which of the seven soul energies is strongest in you. It is a starting point for the exercises in The 7 Energies of the Soul.

free_resources.title: Meditation School Podcasts
free_resources.description: His free podcasts: Grounded Sleep, with guided meditations for falling asleep, Energy Matters with Cody Edner on energy and intuition, and The Conscious Creator on mindfulness and creative work.
